clue.text: Small army of police right in the middle

indicators.note: the right goes into the centre of the police, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: cops is an informal word for police

explanation.surface: A small force of police officers stationed slap bang in the centre of town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the middle' puts R inside COPS. 'Small army' is fair: an army corps is a sizable formation but smaller than a whole army.
explanation.definitionFit: A corps is a military body, an army formation of two or more divisions.

clue.text: Joker on the managing body used to make cartons

parts.note: a joker is a playing card
a board of directors manages a company

explanation.surface: A company prankster sitting on the board of a packaging firm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Joker' looks like a comedian, but it is the playing card. In a down entry 'on' means placed above.
explanation.definitionFit: Stiff pasteboard is the material folded into boxes and packaging.

clue.text: Strengthen the power needed to curb

parts.note: to rein in is to curb, and a rein is a means of restraint
force is power or strength

explanation.surface: A call for reinforcements to restrain something.
explanation.definitionFit: To reinforce is to make stronger by adding support.

clue.text: American news turns up a little later

annotationWithheld.why: American news turns up a little later (4): 'turns up' should reverse NOOS, but neither 'American' nor 'news' gives those letters as held; likely an OCR or source misprint, not found by search
annotationWithheld.clue: American news turns up a little later

clue.text: Metal bangle with no strings attached

definitions.text: Metal bangle with no strings attached

parts.words: Metal bangle with no strings attached
parts.note: read literally, a bangle of yellow metal; read musically, an ensemble of horns and percussion that has no stringed instruments

explanation.surface: A gift of a metal bracelet offered freely, with no obligations.
explanation.walkthrough: 'With no strings attached' looks like the idiom for an unconditional gift, but it really says the band has no violins or cellos.
explanation.definitionFit: Such an ensemble uses only brass and percussion instruments, and its name also literally describes a ring of brass.

clue.text: It involves comparing figures representing vital statistics

definitions.text: It involves comparing figures representing vital statistics

parts.words: It involves comparing figures representing vital statistics
parts.note: figures look like numbers in a census, but are body shapes, and vital statistics are bust, waist and hip measurements

explanation.surface: A demographer weighing up census numbers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vital statistics' suggests births and deaths, but colloquially means a woman's bust-waist-hip measurements, as judged in a pageant.
explanation.definitionFit: A pageant judges contestants on looks and figure.

clue.text: Pop small article under a lump of earth

indicators.note: in a down entry, the piece placed under another comes after it

parts.note: a sod is a clod of turf
A is the indefinite article, a short word

explanation.surface: A fizzy drink can buried under a clod of soil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pop' looks like a bang or a verb, but it is a fizzy drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Soda and pop are both names for a fizzy soft drink.

clue.text: Claim territory from queen named after nine dead predecessors

parts.note: Anne was a queen of Great Britain
a monarch following nine of the same name would be numbered tenth, X in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A new queen staking out land in honour of the many monarchs before her.
explanation.walkthrough: A queen preceded by nine others of the name would be 'the tenth', written X.
explanation.definitionFit: To annex is to seize and add a territory to one's own state.

clue.text: Vision of sleep with 500 plus 480 sheets

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500
an old ream was 480 sheets of paper

explanation.surface: Seeing visions of piles of paper while asleep.
explanation.walkthrough: A ream is now usually 500 sheets, but the traditional ream was 480.
explanation.definitionFit: A dream is the series of images experienced during sleep.

clue.text: Animal horn I carve

indicators.note: to carve something is to cut it into a new shape, so these letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: Someone sculpting an animal horn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carve' rearranges the letters of HORN I.
explanation.definitionFit: The rhinoceros is a large horned mammal of Africa and Asia.

clue.text: Plenty for ball which follows the annual staff fight?

definitions.text: Plenty for ball which follows the annual staff fight?

parts.words: Plenty for ball which follows the annual staff fight?
parts.note: the clue imagines the dance that follows a yearly staff tea party, which British slang calls a fight named after a small sweet roll; run together, that dance's name means plenty

explanation.surface: A lavish dance put on after the yearly office party.
explanation.walkthrough: British slang calls a tea party or social do a 'bun fight'; the dance after one is named for the roll, and that phrase runs together into one word.
explanation.definitionFit: Abundance is a plentiful supply, more than enough of something.

clue.text: Deputy to an assistant groom is a mere underling

definitions.meaning: a strapper is a stable hand, so one under him is a sub-groom
a person of minor rank, a subordinate

explanation.definitionFit: An understrapper is a petty subordinate; literally one below a strapper, a groom who harnesses horses.

clue.text: Light yellow polish

definitions.meaning: a pale yellowish-beige colour, like leather
to rub a surface until it shines

explanation.definitionFit: Buff is a pale tan shade named after buffalo leather, and to buff is to shine with a soft cloth.

clue.text: Room for mental improvement

definitions.meaning: a room in a house used for reading and writing
the application of the mind to learning

explanation.definitionFit: A study is a private work room, and study is the effort of acquiring knowledge.

clue.text: Feller's equipment is returned by Monday for test

indicators.note: returned means sent back, so the word for the feller's tool is read backwards

parts.note: a feller is someone who cuts down trees, and an axe is the tool used

explanation.surface: A lumberjack hands back his tools at the start of the week to be tested.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is returned' turns AXE into EXA. 'Feller' looks like an informal 'fellow' but means a tree-cutter.
explanation.definitionFit: An exam is an examination, a formal test of knowledge.

clue.text: Pine after a venerated man before all others

parts.note: a fir is a pine-like conifer
ST is the abbreviation for saint, a venerated person

explanation.surface: Yearning for a holy man above everyone else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pine' looks like a verb of longing, but it is the tree.
explanation.definitionFit: First means ahead of everyone, in the leading place.

clue.text: Perhaps it is always included in a birthday honour

indicators.note: the word for always goes within the honour, one piece set inside the other

parts.note: the MBE, Member of the Order of the British Empire, is awarded in the monarch's birthday honours
ay, also spelt aye, is an old word for ever or always

explanation.surface: Wondering whether one is always on the birthday honours list.
explanation.walkthrough: The Birthday Honours is the British monarch's annual list of awards such as the MBE.
explanation.definitionFit: Maybe is another word for possibly.

clue.text: It means a new life for blooming horse guide

parts.note: a rein is the strap used to steer a horse
a carnation is a flower, something in bloom

explanation.surface: A guide to keeping horses that promises a fresh start in life.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blooming' looks like the British mild intensifier, but it is a flower, the carnation.
explanation.definitionFit: Reincarnation is rebirth of the soul in another body, a second existence.

clue.text: I order a beer-tin for one sure to appreciate it

indicators.note: to order is to arrange, so these letters are put into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A man at the bar asking for a can of beer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'order' looks like asking for a drink at the bar, but it rearranges A BEER-TIN, with I kept in front.
explanation.definitionFit: A drunkard, as a noun, is someone who would enjoy a beer.

clue.text: A fresh run ordered by a Fleet Street production manager

definitions.text: ordered by a Fleet Street production manager

parts.note: fresh means new
a sprint is a fast run

explanation.surface: A print run commissioned by a newspaper's production chief.
explanation.walkthrough: Fleet Street is the London street long synonymous with the British press.
explanation.definitionFit: Cheap paper used for newspapers is bought in by a paper's production department.

clue.text: Maybe a bench for making up and preparing poultry

definitions.text: Maybe a bench for making up
definitions.meaning: a piece of bedroom furniture with a mirror, where make-up is applied
dressing is preparing a bird for cooking, and a table bird is poultry raised for eating

explanation.definitionFit: It is a bedroom vanity unit, and read in two parts it is getting a table fowl ready to cook.

clue.text: Reserve of one likely to finish up on the shelf

definitions.meaning: to engage a seat or room in advance

definitions.text: one likely to finish up on the shelf
definitions.meaning: a volume that ends up stored on a bookshelf

explanation.definitionFit: To book is to reserve in advance, and a bound volume normally lives on a shelf.

clue.text: Makes fire waters

definitions.meaning: streams; burn is the Scottish word for a brook

explanation.definitionFit: To burn is to set on fire, and in Scotland burns are small streams.

clue.text: Meats which are tainted with aluminium

parts.note: food gone off is spoiled or tainted
Al is the chemical symbol for aluminium

explanation.surface: Meat contaminated by an aluminium container.
explanation.definitionFit: Offal means the edible organs of a slaughtered animal, such as liver and kidneys.

clue.text: Boy returning to Arab area gets award for bravery

parts.note: ME stands for Middle East, home of the Arab world

indicators.note: returning means going back, so the word for boy is read backwards

parts.note: a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: A youth comes home to the Middle East and is decorated for courage.
explanation.walkthrough: ME (Middle East) is a standard crossword abbreviation; 'Arab area' points to it.
explanation.definitionFit: A medal is a metal disc given as a decoration, often for gallantry.

clue.text: Support provided by the stage management

definitions.meaning: something that holds up or bears weight
an object used on stage, supplied by the stage crew

explanation.definitionFit: A prop is a supporting post, and props, short for properties, are the objects a theatre's stage team supplies.

clue.text: Foreign capital at the very heart of Czechoslovakia

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the central part of the long country name

explanation.surface: A capital city located at the centre of the former Czechoslovakia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at the very heart of' picks letters from inside CZECHOSLOVAKIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Oslo is the capital city of Norway.

clue.text: South botanical gardens not kept straight

parts.note: Kew Gardens in west London is the national botanical garden

explanation.surface: Gardens in the south whose rows are crooked.
explanation.walkthrough: Kew is the Royal Botanic Gardens in southwest London.
explanation.definitionFit: Skew means slanting or askew, not in line.

clue.text: Decline a gratuity? What a load of rubbish!

definitions.meaning: to turn down a tip offered for service
a dump where loads of waste are left

explanation.definitionFit: Split as a phrase it means turning down a tip; as a noun it is a rubbish dump.

clue.text: Uniform colour for articulated vehicle accessory

indicators.note: articulated means spoken clearly, signalling that the phrase is said out loud

parts.note: a car key is the device for starting a car

explanation.surface: A colour scheme chosen for the fittings of an articulated lorry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'articulated' suggests a lorry with a hinged trailer (an artic), but here it means pronounced: CAR KEY in a non-rhotic British accent sounds like the colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Khaki is the dull brownish-yellow of military uniforms.

clue.text: Part of the pub which admits only tourers

definitions.text: Part of the pub which admits only tourers

parts.words: Part of the pub which admits only tourers
parts.note: a saloon is also a type of car, as is a tourer, so a pub room named after cars might be imagined to admit only cars

explanation.surface: A section of a pub reserved for travelling tourists.
explanation.walkthrough: A saloon bar is the more comfortable lounge of a British pub; saloons and tourers are both car body styles.
explanation.definitionFit: The saloon bar is the better-furnished room of a traditional British pub, as opposed to the public bar.

clue.text: Seize by force and strew all over the place

indicators.note: something all over the place is in disorder, so these letters are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: Grabbing things violently and scattering them everywhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'all over the place' rearranges the letters of STREW.
explanation.definitionFit: To wrest is to twist or pull something away violently from someone.
